newsitem.title: ITALY: VW buys more Italian components this year.
newsitem.headline: VW buys more Italian components this year.

text.p: Europe's largest carmaker, Volkswagen AG (VW), is increasing its purchases of Italian components this year and has already exceeded a forecast budget of 573 million marks with purchases worth 644 million marks.
Turin chamber of commerce chairman Giuseppe Pichetto gave the details to reporters at a conference to present the International Automotive Industry Week to be held in Turin from November 19 to 22.

In 1997, VW expects to increase buying in Italy to a value of one billion marks, Pichetto said, adding that also Ford "is about to invest 1.5 trillion lire for Italian components." He gave no further details.
